infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Lexi uses the camera so you can send photos and live shots into your conversation.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Lexi needs photo library access to attach images to your messages.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Lexi uses the microphone for voice messages.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Lexi can use your location to give context-aware answers.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Lexi can read your contacts to help you message, call, or look someone up.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Lexi can read your calendar to help you plan and manage events.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Lexi can read and create reminders for you.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Lexi uses motion data for activity-aware features.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Use Face ID to unlock Lexi.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Lexi uses Bluetooth to interact with nearby devices.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Lexi uses the local network to discover devices.
